summary: Galiano Gold Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing revisions to its Omnibus Equity Incentive Plan, incorporating suggestions from Institutional Shareholder Services. The amendments require shareholder approval for certain changes like extending option terms, reducing exercise prices, or allowing transfers. The revised plan replaces a prior version in the management information circular and will be voted on at the June 11, 2026 annual meeting. The board recommends a FOR vote. This is a routine equity plan amendment with no acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation. No deal terms apply.
